notes.title: Update – Revoked Game Keys
notes.notes:
[h3]If you have encountered a problem with your House of Ashes Steam key being revoked,[b] please contact the reseller who sold you the key[/b]. We have provided [b]all official resellers with replacement keys[/b] for this purpose.

If you have already contacted your reseller and they were not able to send a replacement key, [b]please contact the [url=https://bnent.eu/TDPSupport]Bandai Namco Support Team[/url][/b].
 
We will ask you to send [b]the key that has been revoked plus a copy of your purchase invoice from the reseller[/b]  (most digital resellers will send an email invoice after purchase). With this information, our team will be able to issue a replacement key.
 
Our sincere apologies for this inconvenience. We thank you for your patience and hope that after this issue is resolved, you will continue to enjoy [i][b]The Dark Pictures: House of Ashes[/b][/i].[/h3]

notes.title: Patch 1.04 is live 📜
notes.notes:
[h2]This update to House of Ashes implements stability fixes in all game modes, including Shared Story, and fixes a block caused by non-playable characters in "Enemy of My Enemy”.[/h2]


We are actively working on the following known issues:
[list]
[*] Endless loading screen in “The Horror”,
[*] Missing levels in Scene Selection,
[*] Game freezes in “Daylight”,
[*] An endless loading screen in “The Temple” when in multiplayer mode.
[/list]
 
An upcoming patch is in progress to fix these issues.
